summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Orbis Investment Management Limited crossed the 5% threshold, holding 3,166,357 shares (5.08% of share capital and voting rights) as of May 8, 2026. This is a routine major shareholder notification under the Danish Capital Markets Act, not a special situation. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or deal structure are involved. The filing is informational only, with no action required from Genmab or shareholders. This is analogous to a US Schedule 13D or 13G filing and does not trigger any special-situation category.
